answer: A forged ticket gets no live signal: each weighing is checked in the ledger. That standing comes from a weighmaster licence: a weights exam, a 1,500-unit bond, 60 supervised days. The licence covers one sealed station, its quartz load cell filed under the key: one station, one identity. Each fake costs an exam, 1,500 units, 60 days; 100 fakes cost 150,000 units, 6,000 days. Cheapest cheat: buy a retiring weighmaster's station for 6,000 units — the seller signs the transfer with the weighmaster's quill and surrenders their own licence, so every fake still costs one real weighmaster.
